settings.title: Command Notifier
settings.program.title: Program
settings.program.description: The program to run, as a full path (/config/scripts/notify.sh). It is started directly, never through a shell, as the user tuliprox runs as, and gets the event as JSON on its standard input.
settings.args.title: Arguments
settings.args.description: One entry per argument, passed as written. They are not read by a shell, so there is nothing to quote. Do not put a credential here: arguments are visible in the process list.
settings.timeout_secs.title: Timeout (seconds)
settings.timeout_secs.description: How long the program may run before it is stopped and the notification is retried. 1 to 25; the default is 20.
settings.routing.title: Routing (applied by tuliprox, not by the plugin)
settings.routing.description: Per-channel routing of the messaging outbox, the same block every messaging channel takes. Every field is optional; an empty block inherits the global notify_on.
settings.routing.notify_on.title: notify_on override
settings.routing.notify_on.description: Event id globs that replace the global notify_on for this channel (for example playlist.update.*).
settings.routing.min_severity.title: Minimum severity (routing)
settings.routing.min_severity.descriptio: Host-side severity floor, judged on the event's registry severity before the plugin is called.
settings.routing.quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
settings.routing.quiet_hours.description: HH:MM-HH:MM local time. Notifications inside the window are deferred, never dropped.
settings.routing.max_per_hour.title: Max per hour
settings.routing.max_per_hour.descriptio: Circuit breaker: after this many notifications in an hour the channel sends one suppression notice and goes quiet.
settings.routing.dedup_window_secs.title: Dedup window (seconds)
settings.routing.dedup_window_secs.descr: Suppress a repeated dedup key for this many seconds.
